e.title: IAIS（国际保险监督官协会）：全球保险监管标准、MMoU 与 2026 香港年会
e.title_en: IAIS (International Association of Insurance Supervisors): global insurance supervisory standards, the MMoU, and the 2026 Hong Kong Annual Conference
e.title_hk: IAIS（國際保險監督官協會）：全球保險監管標準、MMoU 與 2026 香港年會
e.summary: 全球保险监管者的标准制定机构：发布保险核心原则、保险资本标准（ICS）与可比性评估，设多边谅解备忘录（MMoU）与成员评估计划，并公布 2026 年年会将于 11 月 12–13 日在香港举行、由香港保监局主办
e.summary_en: The global standard-setter for insurance supervisors: it issues the Insurance Core Principles, the Insurance Capital Standard (ICS) and comparability assessments, runs the Multilateral Memorandum of Understanding (MMoU) and a member assessment programme, and announces that its 2026 Annual Conference will be held in Hong Kong on 12–13 November, hosted by the Hong Kong Insurance Authority
e.summary_hk: 全球保險監管者的標準制定機構：發布保險核心原則、保險資本標準（ICS）與可比性評估，設多邊諒解備忘錄（MMoU）與成員評估計劃，並公布 2026 年年會將於 11 月 12–13 日在香港舉行、由香港保監局主辦
e.body:
**IAIS（International Association of Insurance Supervisors，国际保险监督官协会）** 是**全球保险监管者的标准制定机构**（站点标题实测 **「International Association of Insurance Supervisors」**）。本条目补的是**「IAIS 机构本身」**——⭐ **与池内已有条目的分工必须写明**：**池内已有 [[iais-icp]]（保险核心原则与共同框架，属其一个子页）与 [[iais-gimar]]（全球保险市场报告，其 PDF 实测托管在 NAIC 站点上）**——**即「有它的两份文件、没有它的机构」**，**这正是本条的补位点**（**与第 310 轮 [[aae]] 的补位方式同型**）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **首页 127.3KB，标题「International Association of Insurance Supervisors」**；⭐ **「IAIS Members（成员）」页 `/about-the-iais/iais-members/` 实测 93.9KB**；⭐ **「Insurance Capital Standard（保险资本标准）」页 `/activities-topics/standard-setting/insurance-capital-standard/` 实测 123.8KB**——**这是池内两份文件都没有覆盖的一项核心标准**；⭐ **「IAIS MMoU（多边谅解备忘录）」页 `/about-the-iais/mmou/` 实测 107.0KB**；⭐⭐ **「IAIS Annual Conference 2026」页 `/news-and-events/2026hongkong/` 实测 148.5KB，标题「IAIS Annual Conference 2026」**。**导航逐字实测揭示的机构结构**：**About the IAIS** 含 **Organisation**、**What we do**、**IAIS Leadership**、**IAIS Secretariat**、**Organisational structure**、**Strategic Plan and Roadmap**、**Annual reports**、**Diversity, equity and inclusion**、**Policies and Procedures**、**Recruitment**、⭐ **IAIS Members**、**How to join**、⭐ **MMoU**、⭐ **Distinguished Fellows**、**Partners**、**Stakeholder engagement**；**Activities & Topics** 含 **Standard-setting（ICP and ComFrame、Insurance Capital Standard、Comparability Assessment）** 与 **Implementation assessment（Member Assessment Programme）**；**Publications** 含 **Application Papers**、**Assessment Reports**、⭐ **GIMAR**、**Issues Papers**、**Other supporting material**、⭐ **Translations（译文）**；**News & Events** 含 **Latest news**、**Press releases**、**Media centre**、**Newsletter**、**Email alerts**、**Events**、**Global Seminar Leadership Dialogue 2026**、**Stakeholder events**，以及**历届年会档案**（实测含 **2022 Santiago、2023 Tokyo、2024、2025、2027** 等）。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐ 最直接可用的一条：IAIS 2026 年年会将在香港举行**——该页正文逐字实测：**「The IAIS Annual Conference will take place on 12-13 November in China, Hong Kong」**，并写明 **「A special thank you to the Insurance Authority Hong Kong for hosting the event」**（**由香港保险业监管局主办**），议程实测含 **「12 November | Opening remarks from the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region」**；⭐ **实测列出的核心议题包含「Understanding emerging risks, such as the transformative impact of AI, and their implications for insurance supervision」与「The role of insurance in building resilience amidst growing natural catastrophe risks and shifting societal trends」**——**即 AI 对监管的冲击与巨灾韧性**；**页面上实测有 Registration 入口**。**对本站读者（岭南 RIAA 学生、且在香港），这是一个有明确日期、地点与议题的本地国际会议**——**本词条把它作为首要可行动信息呈现**。**② 补上「监督官的标准体系」这一层**——**池内监管侧此前极密（[[eiopa-registers]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]]、[[acpr]]、[[ivass]]、[[fsca]]、[[cmf-chile]]、[[seddk]]、[[acaps-morocco]]、[[ira-kenya]]、[[finanssivalvonta]]、[[finansinspektionen]]、[[dnb]]、[[nfra-statistics]]、[[fss-korea-insurance]] 等，共二十余条国家/地区监管者）**，**但那是「各国监管者的产出」；IAIS 是「各国监管者共同的准则来源」**；**本轮把 ICS（保险资本标准）与可比性评估补上——这与池内 [[insurance-scr-data]]、[[ggsolvencyii]]、[[sii-spread-risk-scr]] 的各国资本口径正好构成「国际标准 vs 各国实施」的对照**（**注意：本次未打开 ICS 正文，故不转述其方法与校准**）。**③ MMoU（多边谅解备忘录）是跨境监管信息交换的机制**——**与池内 [[eiopa-registers]] 的「登记与处罚数据」、[[susep-sro]] 的「逐笔登记」属不同的跨境协作手段**；**本轮同轮的 [[assal]] 也有自己的 MMoU**，**两者并读可见「全球机制如何被区域组织复制」**。**④ 「Translations（译文）」栏目对本站三语读者有实际价值**——**IAIS 材料存在多语版本**（**本次仅核实该栏目存在，未核实含哪些语种、是否含中文**）。**⑤ 「Distinguished Fellows」是少见机制**——**协会向个人授予杰出会员身份**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与四个页面的存在、标题、页面体量、导航逐字实测的机构结构与出版物分类、以及 2026 年会页的日期、地点、主办方、议题与议程片段**，**但未打开成员名录、未打开 ICS 正文、未打开 MMoU 文本、未打开任何出版物或译文页、未核实年会是否仍需报名或是否对公众开放**，因此**不能转述成员数量与名单、ICS 的方法与校准、MMoU 的条款、任何报告的结论或年会的具体安排**；**② ⭐ 「2026 年会在香港、11 月 12-13 日、由香港保监局主办」均为该页正文逐字实测**，**但本次未核实报名条件、费用、名额或是否已开放注册**——**词条内以「实测有 Registration 入口」表述，不主张报名状态**；**③ 「标准制定机构」这一定位依据站点自述栏目（Standard-setting、ICP、ICS、Comparability Assessment）**，**本次未打开任何一页说明其法律地位或与各国监管的约束关系**——**词条内因此不主张其准则具有强制力**；**④ 站点实测在 `iaisweb.org` 与 `iais.org` 两个域名上均可访问，且大量内部链接指向 `iais.org`**，**本词条引用的 URL 均为 `iais.org` 下的实测路径**；**⑤ 「Translations」栏目含哪些语种本次未核实**；**⑥ 历届年会档案的完整年份列表本次未逐项核实**（**实测可见 2022 Santiago、2023 Tokyo、2024、2025、2027 等**）；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** IAIS 提供精算软件、模型或数据下载**。**核实说明**：首页（127.3KB）、`/about-the-iais/iais-members/`（93.9KB）、`/activities-topics/standard-setting/insurance-capital-standard/`（123.8KB）、`/about-the-iais/mmou/`（107.0KB）、`/news-and-events/2026hongkong/`（148.5KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取标题、导航与年会正文；**未打开成员名录、ICS 正文、MMoU 文本、出版物或译文页**。
e.body_en:
**IAIS (the International Association of Insurance Supervisors)** is **the global standard-setter for insurance supervisors** (measured site title **"International Association of Insurance Supervisors"**). This entry adds **the IAIS institution itself** — ⭐ **and its division of labour with existing entries must be stated**: **the corpus already holds [[iais-icp]] (the Insurance Core Principles and ComFrame, one of its subpages) and [[iais-gimar]] (the Global Insurance Market Report, whose PDF measurably sits on NAIC’s site)** — **i.e. "its two documents are present, the institution is not"**, **which is exactly the gap this entry fills** (**the same pattern as [[aae]] in round 310**).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **homepage is 127.3KB with the measured title "International Association of Insurance Supervisors"**; ⭐ the **"IAIS Members" page measures 93.9KB**; ⭐ the **"Insurance Capital Standard" page measures 123.8KB** — **a core standard that neither existing corpus entry covers**; ⭐ the **"IAIS MMoU" page measures 107.0KB**; ⭐⭐ the **"IAIS Annual Conference 2026" page measures 148.5KB with the measured title "IAIS Annual Conference 2026"**. **Navigation read verbatim reveals the institutional structure**: under **About the IAIS** — **Organisation**, **What we do**, **IAIS Leadership**, **IAIS Secretariat**, **Organisational structure**, **Strategic Plan and Roadmap**, **Annual reports**, **Diversity, equity and inclusion**, **Policies and Procedures**, **Recruitment**, ⭐ **IAIS Members**, **How to join**, ⭐ **MMoU**, ⭐ **Distinguished Fellows**, **Partners** and **Stakeholder engagement**; under **Activities & Topics** — **Standard-setting (ICP and ComFrame, Insurance Capital Standard, Comparability Assessment)** and **Implementation assessment (Member Assessment Programme)**; under **Publications** — **Application Papers**, **Assessment Reports**, ⭐ **GIMAR**, **Issues Papers**, **Other supporting material** and ⭐ **Translations**; under **News & Events** — **Latest news**, **Press releases**, **Media centre**, **Newsletter**, **Email alerts**, **Events**, **Global Seminar Leadership Dialogue 2026**, **Stakeholder events** and **an archive of past annual conferences** (measurably including **2022 Santiago, 2023 Tokyo, 2024, 2025 and 2027**).

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐ The most directly actionable item: the IAIS 2026 Annual Conference will be held in Hong Kong** — the page states verbatim **"The IAIS Annual Conference will take place on 12-13 November in China, Hong Kong"**, adding **"A special thank you to the Insurance Authority Hong Kong for hosting the event"**, with an agenda measurably reading **"12 November | Opening remarks from the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region"**; ⭐ **the measured key themes include "Understanding emerging risks, such as the transformative impact of AI, and their implications for insurance supervision" and "The role of insurance in building resilience amidst growing natural catastrophe risks and shifting societal trends"** — **AI’s impact on supervision and catastrophe resilience**; **a Registration entry point is measurably present**. **For this wiki’s readers (Lingnan RIAA students, in Hong Kong), this is a local international conference with a definite date, place and agenda** — **the entry presents it as the lead actionable item**. **② It adds the layer of supervisory standards** — **the corpus’s regulatory side is very dense** ([[eiopa-registers]], [[apra-insurance-statistics]], [[acpr]], [[ivass]], [[fsca]], [[cmf-chile]], [[seddk]], [[acaps-morocco]], [[ira-kenya]], [[finanssivalvonta]], [[finansinspektionen]], [[dnb]], [[nfra-statistics]], [[fss-korea-insurance]] and more, over twenty national or regional supervisors), **but those are the outputs of individual supervisors; the IAIS is where supervisors’ shared standards come from**; **this round adds the ICS and comparability assessment — setting them against the national capital regimes in [[insurance-scr-data]], [[ggsolvencyii]] and [[sii-spread-risk-scr]] as "international standard versus national implementation"** (**note: the ICS text was not opened, so its method and calibration are not restated**). **③ The MMoU is a cross-border supervisory information-sharing mechanism** — **a different instrument from the registration and sanction data in [[eiopa-registers]] or the operation-level registry in [[susep-sro]]**; **[[assal]] in the same round also has its own MMoU**, **and reading both shows how a global mechanism is replicated by a regional body**. **④ The "Translations" section has practical value for this trilingual wiki** — **IAIS material exists in multiple languages** (**only the existence of the section was verified, not which languages or whether Chinese is included**). **⑤ "Distinguished Fellows" is an uncommon mechanism** — **the association granting an individual distinction**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage and four pages’ existence, titles and sizes, the institutional structure and publication categories read verbatim from navigation, and the 2026 conference page’s date, place, host, themes and an agenda fragment**, **but opened no member directory, no ICS text, no MMoU text, no publication or translation page, and did not establish whether the conference still requires registration or is open to the public**, so **no member count, roster, ICS method or calibration, MMoU clause, report conclusion or conference arrangement can be restated**; **② ⭐ "the 2026 conference is in Hong Kong on 12–13 November hosted by the Hong Kong Insurance Authority" is read verbatim from that page**, **but registration conditions, fees, capacity and whether registration has opened were not verified** — **the entry says only that a Registration entry point is measurably present and does not claim registration status**; **③ the "standard-setter" positioning rests on the site’s own sections (Standard-setting, ICPs, ICS, Comparability Assessment)**, **and no page stating its legal status or the binding force of its standards was opened** — **so the entry does not claim its standards are binding**; **④ the site is measurably reachable on both `iaisweb.org` and `iais.org`, with many internal links pointing to `iais.org`**, **and the URLs cited here are measured paths under `iais.org`**; **⑤ which languages the Translations section contains was not verified**; **⑥ the full list of past conference years was not verified item by item** (**2022 Santiago, 2023 Tokyo, 2024, 2025 and 2027 are measurably visible**); **⑦** this entry **does not claim the IAIS provides actuarial software, models or data downloads**. **Verification note**: the homepage (127.3KB), `/about-the-iais/iais-members/` (93.9KB), `/activities-topics/standard-setting/insurance-capital-standard/` (123.8KB), `/about-the-iais/mmou/` (107.0KB) and `/news-and-events/2026hongkong/` (148.5KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with titles, navigation and conference text read verbatim; **no member directory, ICS text, MMoU text, publication or translation page was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**IAIS（International Association of Insurance Supervisors，國際保險監督官協會）** 是**全球保險監管者的標準制定機構**。本條目補的是**「IAIS 機構本身」**——⭐ **與池內已有條目的分工必須寫明**：**池內已有 [[iais-icp]]（保險核心原則與共同框架，屬其一個子頁）與 [[iais-gimar]]（全球保險市場報告，其 PDF 實測託管在 NAIC 站點上）**——**即「有它的兩份文件、沒有它的機構」**（**與第 310 輪 [[aae]] 的補位方式同型**）。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：⭐ **首頁 127.3KB**；⭐ **「IAIS Members」頁 93.9KB**；⭐ **「Insurance Capital Standard（保險資本標準）」頁 123.8KB**——**這是池內兩份文件都沒有覆蓋的一項核心標準**；⭐ **「IAIS MMoU」頁 107.0KB**；⭐⭐ **「IAIS Annual Conference 2026」頁 148.5KB**。**導航逐字實測機構結構**：**About the IAIS** 含 Organisation／What we do／IAIS Leadership／IAIS Secretariat／Organisational structure／Strategic Plan and Roadmap／Annual reports／**IAIS Members**／**How to join**／⭐**MMoU**／⭐**Distinguished Fellows**／Partners／Stakeholder engagement；**Activities & Topics** 含 **Standard-setting（ICP and ComFrame、Insurance Capital Standard、Comparability Assessment）** 與 **Implementation assessment（Member Assessment Programme）**；**Publications** 含 Application Papers／Assessment Reports／⭐**GIMAR**／Issues Papers／⭐**Translations（譯文）**；**News & Events** 含歷屆年會檔案（實測含 **2022 Santiago、2023 Tokyo、2024、2025、2027**）。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐ 最直接可用的一條：IAIS 2026 年年會將在香港舉行**——該頁正文逐字實測 **「The IAIS Annual Conference will take place on 12-13 November in China, Hong Kong」**，並寫明 **「A special thank you to the Insurance Authority Hong Kong for hosting the event」**（**由香港保險業監管局主辦**），議程實測含 **「12 November | Opening remarks from the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region」**；⭐ **核心議題實測含「AI 對保險監管的衝擊」與「巨災韌性」**；**頁面實測有 Registration 入口**。**對本站讀者（嶺南 RIAA 學生、且在香港），這是一個有明確日期、地點與議題的本地國際會議**。**② 補上「監督官的標準體系」這一層**——**池內監管側此前極密（二十餘條國家/地區監管者），但那是「各國監管者的產出」；IAIS 是「各國監管者共同的準則來源」**；**本輪補上 ICS 與可比性評估，與池內 [[insurance-scr-data]]、[[ggsolvencyii]] 構成「國際標準 vs 各國實施」對照**（**未打開 ICS 正文，故不轉述其方法**）。**③ MMoU 是跨境監管資訊交換機制**——**同輪 [[assal]] 也有自己的 MMoU**，**兩者並讀可見「全球機制如何被區域組織複製」**。**④ 「Translations（譯文）」欄目對本站三語讀者有實際價值**（**僅核實欄目存在，未核實語種**）。**⑤ 「Distinguished Fellows」是少見機制**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁與四個頁面的存在、標題、體量、導航逐字實測的機構結構、以及年會頁的日期、地點、主辦方、議題與議程片段**，**但未打開成員名錄、ICS 正文、MMoU 文本、任何出版物或譯文頁、未核實年會報名狀態**，故**不能轉述成員數量與名單、ICS 方法、MMoU 條款、報告結論或年會具體安排**；**② ⭐ 年會資訊為該頁正文逐字實測**，**但未核實報名條件、費用、名額或是否已開放註冊**——**詞條內僅以「實測有 Registration 入口」表述**；**③ 「標準制定機構」這一定位依據站點自述欄目**，**未打開任何一頁說明其法律地位或準則的約束力**——**故不主張其準則具強制力**；**④ 站點在 `iaisweb.org` 與 `iais.org` 均可訪問，大量內部連結指向 `iais.org`**，**本詞條引用 URL 均為 `iais.org` 下的實測路徑**；**⑤ Translations 欄目的語種未核實**；**⑥ 歷屆年會完整年份未逐項核實**；**⑦** 本詞條**不主張** IAIS 提供精算軟件、模型或數據下載**。**核實說明**：五個 URL 均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取標題、導航與年會正文；**未打開成員名錄、ICS 正文、MMoU 文本、出版物或譯文頁**。
